_note: Hand-curated decklist-name → canonical uvsId mappings for names no normalization rule could ever derive. Read by scripts/build-card-crosswalk.mjs and folded into card-crosswalk.json's byName index. Keys are matched after normalization (lowercased, curly quotes and diacritics folded), so write them in plain lowercase ASCII. Keep each entry's `why` filled in — an override with no reason is indistinguishable from a mistake later.

ball might (i) (anime expo 2022).why: Anime Expo 2022 reskin promo of All Might (VII). Same gameplay card, different art; we hold no record for the promo printing itself, so decklists resolve to the All Might (VII) printing they are actually playing.
